content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

The architecture behind Bitcoin payments for digital downloads is a game changer for creators in countries facing financial isolation. Traditional payment platforms often charge exorbitant fees, limiting profitability. For example, Gumroad charges a steep 10% on every sale, whereas NOWPayments offers a mere 0.5% fee. This difference means that on 100 monthly sales of a $97 product, creators retain an additional $921. The architecture allows creators to own their entire payment and delivery process, providing true sovereignty over their products and revenue.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, this architecture integrates several free and open-source tools to create a seamless experience for both sellers and buyers. Using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, creators can automate the delivery of digital products immediately upon payment confirmation. NOWPayments acts as the payment processor, accepting over 300 cryptocurrencies and ensuring real-time transaction verification. This robust setup not only eliminates reliance on conventional payment platforms but also provides a more efficient means of processing payments, enhancing the overall user experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is specifically designed for digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela, where access to traditional payment platforms is either limited or non-existent. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or digital art, this solution empowers creators to monetize their work without the burden of high transaction fees. It caters to individuals and businesses that seek independence from centralized platforms, allowing them to embrace a more sustainable model for digital commerce.
Eliminate high transaction fees that eat into your profits.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The architecture combines several key components: hosting via GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets. Each element is chosen for its reliability and cost-effectiveness. The integration of NOWPayments ensures that transactions are processed swiftly, with minimal fees. This interconnected framework not only facilitates smooth operations but also bolsters the overall security and ownership of the digital products sold.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this architecture for your own digital products, start by selecting the hosting solution that suits your needs, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, implement the backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle product delivery. Set up a storage solution for orders, such as Supabase or Google Sheets, and finally, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing. For comprehensive guidance, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to expedite your deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Gain full ownership of your digital products and customer data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're searching for ways to sell digital downloads solely through cryptocurrency, consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This resource encompasses all six blueprints and seven templates needed to establish your own sovereign commerce infrastructure. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to access these tools and start your journey.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

Utilize NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency as your payment processor. This platform allows for seamless transactions with low fees, ensuring you retain more revenue from your sales.

Yes, by using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate the delivery of your digital products immediately after payment confirmation, enhancing customer satisfaction.
What are the transaction fees with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of just 0.5% per transaction, significantly less than traditional platforms like Gumroad, which takes 10%.
